caption: The drawing depicts a figure of a woman made from corn husks, shown standing upright against a plain light beige background. She is dressed in a full-length, pleated gown with wide puffed sleeves and a large, prominent bow at the waist, all rendered in shades of light tan and beige to resemble natural corn husk material. Her face is small, with dotted features, and she has brownish hair that appears to be made from fine fibers or threads. Atop her head, she wears a voluminous, gathered bonnet made of the same corn husk material, with a decorative knot or flower at the top. She holds a closed parasol or umbrella in her right hand, made from the same corn husk material as her dress and hat. There are touches of brown highlighting her hair, facial features, and the outline of the parasol. The artist’s signature, "J. Rex Bush," is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll
